decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already captures the extremely slight second-V right-arm extension and preservation of its established slope and geometry.
The existing same-message MODIFY already captures reopening the É accent for the shared reach and terminal study while preserving its established architectural relationship.
The existing same-message MODIFY fully records selection of Option B, the requested terminal variants, and consistent application across the Hero V, second V, and É accent.
Applying the reach refinement consistently to the Hero V and É accent does not change their existing exact peak-alignment rule.
The client limits the requested refinements to the V-system elements and explicitly keeps the remaining architecture unchanged; the E and L requirements remain valid as stated.
The source changes geometry and terminal nuances, not the selected Satin Reflection finish or champagne-gold distribution.
The subtle reach study preserves the second V's established structure and does not alter its existing hierarchy relative to the E, L, Hero V, or É accent.
The source requests terminal and reach refinements while keeping everything else fixed, so the selected Balanced Flow kerning remains unchanged.
The requested right-arm refinement does not change the rule aligning E and L cap height with the second V's left arm.
The source provides design feedback but does not change the requirement to explain the rationale behind review rounds.
Extending the upper right arms while preserving overall geometry does not change the established common baseline for the wordmark.
